admission: Read completed short served/full raw texts with exact conditioning and obtain independent triage; root decides each motif.
Admit only cases whose identical saved short full-TT input reproduces the native symptom; retain nonreproductions.
Group manifests by a recorded positive TT seed, since runner --seeds applies to every case; HF RNG is different, seed does not imply identical sampling.
Verify saved token IDs, sampling1.0/0.95/20, revision and chosen64 TF positions; use unchanged fixtures.
Check host available memory and no prior HF process; forecast from existing matched-length HF results before each bounded launch.
Do not overlap HF CPU load with precision speed-ranking or serving measurement; if any overlap occurs label accuracy-only and repeat timing serially.

initial_control.seeds: One positive short-TT seed per case group initially; no positive seed is known yet.

interpretation: Same semantic symptom on identical short HF input supports reference reproduction only for that diagnostic, not native equivalence or incidence.
A coherent or progressing capped HF output is not positive evidence; extend progressing output cap>=2x and test further seeds before closure.
If HF stays coherent while full TT reliably reproduces, investigate stack with op-level comparison/autofix.
performance_scope: Diagnostic host-wall only; never headline or device performance.
